name: aurora-worker
description: Aurora Music en Cloudflare Workers: gateway, panel de administración e importador (estado en Neon, logos en R2)

scripts.dev: npm run prepare-assets && npx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run prepare-assets && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run prepare-assets && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/check
